svg.text: Terrarium silhouettes — alchemical vessel, tapering, nested cascade tiers
every profile holds 310 across corners × 640 tall — grey = nested cascade cones, dashed = 320 mm bed / footprint limit
1. Alembic
cucurbit belly, hard shoulder, still-head above
2. Cucurbit + cone
straight body, conical head - the plainest still
3. Double gourd
two bellies, upper smaller - one chamber each
4. Ogee / onion
reflex curve, reliquary dome, no straight run anywhere
5. Nested bells
one concave sweep - the nesting IS the silhouette
6. Monstrance
stepped foot, knop, radiant head - most ceremonial
7. Pagoda eaves
flared drip eaves - drops fall clear into open air
8. Pinnacle
single concave taper, stalagmite / gothic spire
9. Pelican
belly with two return arms - the vessel that recirculates
10. Beaked flask
asymmetric retort - a front, a back, and a pouring side
